newsitem.title: FRANCE: Cap welcomes CGIP raised stake.
newsitem.headline: Cap welcomes CGIP raised stake.

text.p: Cap Gemini said on Wednesday that its board welcomed holding company CGIP's increase in its stake in the French computer systems house to 30 percent from 20 percent.

"The management board of Cap Gemini group is pleased to acknowledge CGIP's decision to increase its participation in the company's capital from 20 percent to 30 percent, and to closely support its development over the next years," Cap said in a statement.

"This decision, in line with 15 years of fruitful cooperation between CGIP and Cap Gemini, is both a demonstration of confidence in the group's future and a factor of stabilisation in the ownership in which the management maintains its 17 percent participation," it added.

Cie Generale d'Industrie et de Participations earlier said it spent 1.86 billion francs in raising its stake in Cap. It bought a 24 percent holding from Debis of Germany at 326 francs per share and sold 14 percent of that at 340 francs per share.
